title: acer rubrum subsp. carolinianum
intro: Acer rubrum subsp. carolinianum, commonly known as the Scarlet Oak, is a deciduous tree species native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Scarlet Oak include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Scarlet Oak include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
